## Is Your Feature Request Related to a Problem?

A clear and concise description of the problem you are trying to solve. Example: "I find it frustrating when..."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you would like. Be as specific as possible about how it should work.

## Alternatives You Have Considered

Any other approaches or workarounds you have thought about.

## Where Would This Fit in the Architecture?

If you have read the [README](../../README.md), describe where this change would slot in (e.g. a new repository method, a new Fragment, a new Room table, etc.).

## Additional Context

Add any screenshots, mockups, or references that help illustrate the feature.
